title: VBench-Long, rollf200 x 60 s, generation seed 0

labels.sf+far_denoise: sf + far history read in the last 2 denoising passes at layers 12-29 (commit reads recent frames)
labels.sf_sink: Self-Forcing + 3-frame sink read in every pass (24-frame cache)
labels.sf_sink+rule: sf_sink + Commit Forcing (commit reads the newest 21 real frames)
labels.sf_sink+commit_self: sf_sink, commit reads only its own chunk
labels.idf_sf+rule: ID-Forcing + Commit Forcing (commit reads the previous 2 chunks, not the sink)
labels.sgf+rule: sgf + Commit Forcing (commit reads the newest 9 real frames)
labels.rf_v2: rf, second implementation (SGF code base, 21-frame cache)
labels.context_forcing+rule: context_forcing + Commit Forcing (commit reads the recent real frames)
labels.context_forcing+sink_only: context_forcing, sink removed from the commit only
labels.longlive: LongLive, base (sink 3 + local window 9 in every pass)
labels.longlive+rule: longlive + Commit Forcing (commit reads the newest 12 real frames)
labels.longlive+commit_self: longlive, commit reads only its own chunk
labels.idf_longlive+rule: ID-Forcing + Commit Forcing (commit reads the previous 1-2 chunks, not the sink)
labels.rolling_sink+rule: rolling_sink + Commit Forcing (commit reads real committed history)
